title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
summary: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings｜We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling un

extra.description: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi.
